name: Q4 e-tron
description: The Audi Q4 e-tron (2021–present), on the Volkswagen Group MEB platform shared with the VW ID.4 and Skoda Enyaq, is Audi's volume electric SUV. The Q4 e-tron GT coupe variant adds a sportier profile. Its 77 kWh battery and rear/AWD options represent the accessible tier of Audi's EV strategy.
